decisions.reason: Because it builds on the firm's established automation offer and the firm has strong in-house R&D, management is likely to retain it and learn from early market feedback rather than withdraw it quickly.
As a close extension of the existing loading and manufacturing-system business, it fits the firm's knowledge base and should be kept while the expanding firm refines and commercializes it.

Although this dispensing machine is more distant from the firm's established knowledge base and therefore riskier under absorptive-capacity logic, the firm's own R&D, broad technical capabilities, and the product's 2024 design award make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
